Answer: D
Reason: The combination of a right-sided pleural effusion, right lung atelectasis/hypoplasia, and an enlarged heart shadow with a prominent left second arc (suggesting pulmonary hypertension or increased flow) is characteristic of Scimitar syndrome (hypogenetic lung syndrome), which involves partial anomalous pulmonary venous return (PAPVR) to the IVC.
